channel.title: Kenya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Kenya, every source cited.

item.title: Kenyans sue over Bayern-Ajax match funding
item.description: Six citizens want the High Court to force the government to reveal financial details of the January 5, 2027 football match.

item.title: 25,849 candidates start Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education exams in Kisumu
item.description: Kenya National Examinations Council assures integrity of national tests as 246 schools begin examinations on Monday.

item.title: Kuria questions Gachagua's US relocation threat
item.description: Former CS Moses Kuria criticises remarks by former DP Rigathi Gachagua about moving to America if President Ruto wins 2027.

item.title: Taita Taveta targets US$4.3M potato industry growth
item.description: The county government aims to boost production by improving seed access, farmer training, and market links.
